standard_prerequisites.name: Local lifting
standard_prerequisites.use: Local lift of the section through the surjection.

core_obligations: Base case E^• ≅ E[-n] with E a direct summand of a finite free module: the map factors through the surjection F^{n-1} → Ker(F^n → F^{n+1}) (surjective by the assumed vanishing), and Lemma local-lift-map lifts it locally (proof lines 11689-11699).

General case: the split exact sequence 0 → E^b[-b] → E^• → σ_{≤b-1}E^• → 0 gives a distinguished triangle and the exact sequence of Hom groups in K(O_X); the composition E^b[-b] → F^• is locally homotopic to zero by the base case, and the induced element in Hom(σ_{≤b-1}E^•, F^•) is locally zero by induction (proof lines 11700-11719).
proof_roadmap: Settle the length-one case by lifting sections.
Peel off the top term with the split sequence and induct.
difficulty_reason: Induction on the length of the strictly perfect complex: the base case lifts a section through a surjection via the local-lift lemma, and the general case peels off the top term through a split short exact sequence and the induced exact Hom sequence.
